data.name: Niqa
data.gender_notes: Niqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originally from the Arabic word 'niqāb', this name refers to a veil or covering worn by some Muslim women. It is a symbol of modesty and devotion to one's faith. The name Niqa carries the meaning “Veil” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Niqa usually hope their child will grow to embody veil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Niqa represents the hidden beauty and strength that lies beneath the surface, waiting to be revealed to the world.
data.etymology: Niqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Veil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niqa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نقا
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني النقاء و الطهارة و الصفاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نقا مشتق من الجذر النوني القافي الذي يعني النقاء و الطهارة و الصفاء. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلُكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ' (سورة آل عمران: 195). يرمز الاسم للنقاء الداخلي و الطهارة الروحية و الصفاء القلبي.

in_urdu.name: نقا
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے صفائی، پاکی، اور شفافیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام نقا عربی جڑ ن-ق-ي سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صفائی، پاکی، اور شفافیت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے اور پاکیزگی اور روحانی صفائی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता, और स्पष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम नक़ा अरबी मूल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता, और स्पष्टता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है और आध्यात्मिक पवित्रता और मानसिक स्पष्टता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: نقا
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب دے پاکۍ، سپېڅلتیا، او روڼتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: د نوم نقا د عربي ريښې ن-ق-ي څخه اخیستل شوی دے چې د پاکۍ، سپېڅلتیا، او روڼتیا معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د روحاني پاکۍ او سپېڅلتیا نښه ده.

in_english.name: Niqa
in_english.meaning: The name signifies purity, cleanliness, and clarity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Niqa originates from the Arabic root 'n-q-y' which connotes purity, cleanliness, and clarity. Referenced in several Quranic verses, the name symbolizes inner purity, spiritual cleanliness, and mental clarity. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify these virtues.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Niqa" holds significant cultural meaning as it is derived from the practice of wearing a niqāb, a veil that covers the face and chest. The niqāb is a traditional garment worn by some Muslim women, particularly those who live in more conservative Islamic communities. The practice of wearing a niqāb is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings regarding modesty, privacy, and the protection of women from external gaze and harassment. Niqa as a name may evoke images of strength, resilience, and commitment to religious values, as it represents the wearing of the niqāb as a tangible expression of these beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Niqa" may hold deep spiritual significance for some Muslim women, as the niqāb represents their commitment to Allah and the practice of following Islamic teachings regarding hijab and modesty. The act of covering oneself with a niqāb is seen as an act of submission to Allah and a way to focus on the spiritual aspects of life, rather than being distracted by external appearances or the gaze of others. The name "Niqa" may also serve as a reminder of one's connection to their faith and community, and the importance of staying true to their beliefs in the face of external challenges or pressures.
